page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew, Syriac and Latin mixed in the lines; no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: עשר, עֲשַׂר Pahel Ch. & Syr. Decimare, Decimas dare.
Ethpah. ܐܬܥܣܪ Decimatus est, ad Hebr. 7.9.

עשיראה, עסיראי Ch. Decimus. Hujus etiam usus est in Compositione: ut, הרסראי Undecimus, Num. 25.8. in Jon. תריסראי Duodecimus, Ibidè. תלסרי Decimustertius. Foemin. עסיריתא Decima. In compos. תלסריירת Decima tertia, Genes. 2.21. Jon. &c.
עסרונא, עשרון, עסרון Ch. Decima, Decima pars. Plural. עסרונין.
מעסרא, מעסר Ch. & Syr. Decima. Plur. foemin. מעסרת, Num. 18.28. in Onk. & masc. מעסרי Ibid. in Jon. Syr. ܕܡܥܣܪܐ Decimae.
עפה עפיא Ch. Ramus, Frons. Plur. עפין.
ܦܠܐ Syr. Flos: vel Folium juxta alios, 1. Pet. 1.24. ad Hebr. 12.15.
עפף Ch. & Syr. Duplicare. Futur. תעיף Duplicabis, Exod. 26.9. in Onk. Jonathan habet ex Aphel תעיף, Sic Syr. ad Hebr. 1.12. Duplicabis, complicabis. Deinde in Pahel עפף Conflare, tundere, contundere.
ܕܦܠ Syr. Duplum, duplicatio: ܕܦܠܐ ܕܡܕܦܠܐ Duplum super vos, id est duplo magis, quam vos, Matth. 23.15. Plural. ܕܦܠܝܢ In duplicationibus

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek-looking words are transcribed approximately; several Hebrew and Syriac forms in the scan are unclear and are given as best read. The word "(dere." at the end of the Ch. Duplex line is a catchword-like fragment in the right margin, read as part of "contundere". Page with running head and page number only; the final line "tionibus" continues at the foot right.
